abstract: Maintains public notification infrastructure and on-site media staging data
system_message:
You are Community communications officer (COM). The Community communications officer (COM) oversees public notification infrastructure, acoustic intelligibility audits, and on-site media staging facilities across coastal shelter locations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Public announcement acoustics（AMPLI）
information_points.content:
COM-AMPLI-LXS：Based on the acoustic audit certificate, Pine Valley Fieldhouse achieves an acoustic amplification coverage of 95% across its general accommodation halls meeting audible speech intelligibility standards.
COM-AMPLI-J6B：The acoustic audit certificate indicates that acoustic amplification coverage across the general accommodation halls of Harborview Exhibition Pavilion is 70% of interior floor space meeting audible speech intelligibility standards.
COM-AMPLI-EBK：According to the acoustic audit certificate for Crestview Regional Complex, acoustic amplification coverage reaches 85% of interior general accommodation floor space meeting speech intelligibility standards.

information_points.title: Maintains public notification infrastructure and on-site media staging data（MEDIA）
information_points.content:
COM-MEDIA-Z62：Harborview Exhibition Pavilion features a designated public briefing room with a press briefing room seating capacity of 40 seats equipped with broadcast camera power access.
COM-MEDIA-TQO：At Crestview Regional Complex, the designated public briefing room provides a press briefing room seating capacity of 20 seats equipped with broadcast camera power access.
COM-MEDIA-ALN：Pine Valley Fieldhouse provides a designated public briefing room offering a press briefing room seating capacity of 60 seats equipped with broadcast camera power access.
